description: Detector class name -> catalogue SKU. Lets a stock COCO-pretrained YOLOv8n drive the full pipeline before the fine-tuned shelf detector exists (Phase 1). Once the detector is trained on real SKU classes, Product.detection_class_name takes over and this file can shrink to the leftovers.
notes: Keys are matched case-insensitively. A class with no entry is still detected — it simply reports as an EXTRA (off-planogram) object rather than being silently dropped.
